subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should ordered agent:bootstrap hook handlers remain one uninterrupted mutation chain, or may unrelated event-loop work interleave between handlers?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically implementable, but choosing between atomic bootstrap mutation and improved responsiveness changes the runtime contract and cannot be inferred safely from current documentation or tests.

options.title: Retain atomic dispatch
options.body: Remove only the inter-handler yield while retaining asynchronous reads, cooperative glob traversal, timing diagnostics, and their regression coverage.

options.title: Approve cooperative interleaving
options.body: Keep the yield and explicitly document and test reentrancy and shared bootstrap-event mutation expectations.

options.title: Extract the narrow fix
options.body: Move the asynchronous workspace and glob work into a smaller PR if the hook contract cannot be decided promptly.

recommendation.title: Retain atomic dispatch
recommendation.body: Remove only the inter-handler yield while retaining asynchronous reads, cooperative glob traversal, timing diagnostics, and their regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The bootstrap hook and internal hook contracts appear to originate in and be preserved by his merged feature-history commits.
